classification_guide.explicit: Test-quality correction or audit is a main purpose.
classification_guide.embedded: A separate, evidenced repair inside a broader change.
classification_guide.approach: A substantive verification method addresses a demonstrated gap in existing practice.
classification_guide.proposal: Specific test or evaluation repair detailed in documentation without executing it.

matching_prs.title: docs: Add Mutation-Invariant Mismatch bug pattern (#13)
matching_prs.weakness: The Worker and its mock both shortened fixed-length step arrays, so agreement between them concealed an invariant violation.
matching_prs.remedy: Document a failing test and repair plan for both implementations.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The proposed regression runs validateStateInvariants on state after changing step count and requires 128 slots. The document identifies the corresponding mock resize.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Use an independent invariant when a double can repeat the production mistake.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup FAILURE at 3a930944. GitHub lists E2E Tests as failed. Only documents changed. The proposed regression was not executed by this PR.

matching_prs.title: Identify property-based testing opportunities in Keyboardia
matching_prs.weakness: The skipped browser reorder suite left the reducer operation uncovered in CI, and example cases barely exercised mutation sequences.
matching_prs.remedy: Add reducer-level reorder cases and generated and model-based invariants.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: grid.test.ts compares actual ordered track IDs after moving tracks forward and backward. The state-machine suite generates operations against a reference model.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Put deterministic core invariants in an always-run layer and retain a separate wiring check.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at 0b23083c. The reducer cases do not establish browser pointer or drag behavior.

matching_prs.title: Review & improve Playwright E2E tests with modern best practices
matching_prs.weakness: E2E tests used fixed sleeps and blanket timing-related CI skips.
matching_prs.remedy: Add readiness helpers, fixtures and locator assertions, then restore selected skipped checks.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The playback diff removes its file-level CI skip. Core waits for application readiness and checks rendered states after drag operations.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Wait for the application state under test and keep fixture setup explicit.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at 61b38bbe. The PR retained some environment-specific skips.

matching_prs.title: fix: Remove setPointerCapture breaking drag-to-paint + add test suite
matching_prs.weakness: The shared active-step assertion tried two unavailable ARIA attributes before the class that actually encoded step state. A long synthetic drag also conflated event delivery with editing logic.
matching_prs.remedy: Simplify the page-object oracle and add diagnostic drag coverage.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: expectStepActive replaces two chained caught ARIA matchers with toHaveClass(/active/). The long-drag case records the Playwright limitation.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Use one asserted state contract and distinguish input-driver limitations from a product defect.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at 930ded5c. One 16-step drag was explicitly skipped.

matching_prs.title: refactor: Code deduplication, component extraction, and E2E test fixes
matching_prs.weakness: Many browser scenarios were skipped, including drag and keyboard cases, and some only encountered unavailable UI or unsupported synthetic input.
matching_prs.remedy: Delete skipped browser cases, move verifiable behavior into unit tests, and change browser coverage.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The skipped 16-step drag is deleted. Keyboard tests exercise real reducer state transitions. Firefox is removed from the project matrix.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Before removing a test, identify the behavior its replacement actually observes.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at e8aa63c8. Firefox coverage was dropped. Some replacement tests later proved too indirect, including copied mobile logic addressed in later audits.

matching_prs.title: feat: Mobile interface simplification (portrait + landscape modes)
matching_prs.weakness: Mobile smoke setup could inspect a hidden header first, and rotation waited a fixed 150 ms.
matching_prs.remedy: Check layout-specific visibility and wait for the rendered orientation.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: Commit a0bc0c39 replaces the combined first() lookup with separate header visibility checks, and replaces the sleep with visible portrait header and data-orientation checks.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Poll the state that identifies the new viewport instead of assuming DOM order or a debounce duration.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at 207d57c2.

matching_prs.title: test: Add PBT + integration tests for pattern reversal p-lock preserv…
matching_prs.weakness: Existing rotate/invert suites checked parameter locks, but reverse/mirror coverage could miss lost or misplaced locks.
matching_prs.remedy: Extend generated transforms and client/server fixtures with lock-bearing patterns.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: Generated steps carry correlated optional locks. Reverse/mirror decisions compare positions and values, and client/server tests compare parameterLocks slices.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Generate payloads correlated to their keys and verify they move together through every sibling operation.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at 232a3a57. The integration file uses the client/server simulation available at that revision.

matching_prs.title: feat: Add 5 new instruments + fix silent failure bugs
matching_prs.weakness: The catalog could route a named instrument even when its default scheduled pitch fell outside playableRange or loudness layers were reversed.
matching_prs.remedy: Validate catalog-wide scheduler/manifest compatibility and measured layer levels.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The new validator uses SCHEDULER_BASE_MIDI_NOTE against manifest ranges, and the layer script measures RMS with ffmpeg. Existing routing tests gain base-note checks.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Verify the runtime's normal input against real assets and measure a consequence of each configuration.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at d708155f.

matching_prs.title: feat: Implement Observability 2.0 wide events
matching_prs.weakness: Existing browser tests targeted a Vite URL, with no runner that owned the complete local Workers backend.
matching_prs.remedy: Allow a supplied base URL and run existing Playwright specs against a locally started Wrangler backend.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The runner polls Wrangler readiness and fails its startup deadline. The Playwright config accepts PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Exercise an existing browser suite against the same backend implementation that handles user requests.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at 59947b1a.

matching_prs.title: Add solo track filtering to PitchOverview component
matching_prs.weakness: Workers-pool tests depended on forbidden host filesystem access, and reorder fixtures still used obsolete fromIndex inputs.
matching_prs.remedy: Pass CSS through a test binding and send real track IDs to the reorder contract.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: Configuration reads CSS before the sandbox starts. Tests consume env-bound text and replace a negative index with an unknown track ID.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Give sandboxed tests their inputs through supported interfaces and exercise the current public request shape.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at cf351f17. The new solo-track product tests are incidental to these separate repairs.

matching_prs.title: Audio engine review: fix 7 + 9 findings, per-track refactor, hook hardening
matching_prs.weakness: A staging meter test could pass without observing a signal, and two tracks could appear healthy while sharing one meter.
matching_prs.remedy: Require actual nonzero staging meter samples and prove independence of two browser-observed channels.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The staging assertion requires nonzero samples. The new two-pattern test requires both tracks to animate and absolute Pearson correlation below 0.9. A separate contract checks audio mocks against production APIs.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Use distinguishable stimuli when multiple outputs might secretly be the same signal.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at 5ffecc4f. The staging suite is explicitly gated and the aggregate check does not establish staging execution.

matching_prs.title: fix: integrate TrackDrawer into landscape mobile mode
matching_prs.weakness: A test asserted the visible defect as correct behavior by requiring the landscape track drawer to stay hidden.
matching_prs.remedy: Reverse the oracle and exercise controls and the drawer's open/close transitions.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The diff removes not.toBeVisible() on .track-drawer and checks visible Copy controls, tap-to-open, and repeated-tap behavior.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Test the intended user action and its visible consequence, including a regression that fails on the old behavior.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at b9093e94.

matching_prs.title: docs: add June 2026 sample & audio pipeline audit
matching_prs.weakness: Manifest and routing checks could miss wrong sounding pitches, clipped samples and a scheduler time lost at the engine boundary.
matching_prs.remedy: Add decoded-asset inspections and direct engine-to-instrument forwarding assertions.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The scripts decode files with ffmpeg, estimate measured pitch and detect signal defects. The regression asserts playNote receives scheduled time previously hard-coded to zero.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Inspect delivered media and capture values at the runtime handoff that must preserve them.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at d258354e. The Python tools explicitly describe themselves as developer checks outside CI.

matching_prs.title: Post-merge cleanup: stale docs, orphaned canary, sync preview API, test hardening
matching_prs.weakness: A fixed decimal precision made a property of floating-point sums flaky, and visual snapshots were absent for Linux.
matching_prs.remedy: Use a scale-dependent rounding bound and supply Linux Playwright baselines.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The reversal property changes to abs(mean(values) - mean(reversed)) <= 4 * Number.EPSILON * sumAbs, replacing toBeCloseTo(..., 10).
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Make numeric tolerances track the scale and operation that produce roundoff.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at daabb137.

matching_prs.title: Fix silent Sub Bass and harden audio regressions
matching_prs.weakness: A successful scheduler call could still produce silence, and a broad range audit could mask failed or skipped voices.
matching_prs.remedy: Check actual per-instrument browser audio, emit range skips and bound session size.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The range suite records skipped notes and requires live masterPeak. The all-instruments suite checks track and master analyser output with one target sounding.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Assert the output where the user receives it, and isolate each source so another source cannot satisfy the check.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at adf77a9e.

matching_prs.title: Adopt Durable Object eviction test helpers; fix two hibernation-recovery bugs
matching_prs.weakness: The integration harness could exercise normal mutations but could not induce real Durable Object eviction and hibernation recovery.
matching_prs.remedy: Upgrade the Workers test harness and cover real sockets, storage restoration and seeded state transitions.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: A test persists a real WebSocket mutation then evicts the object. Other cases assert the KV lag, authoritative HTTP read and eventual disconnect convergence.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Drive lifecycle transitions in the runtime and assert the documented durability boundary.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at 9ba68ecf.

matching_prs.title: Add full sampled-instrument quality audit tooling
matching_prs.weakness: The existing independent sample validators and advisory browser suite could miss codec failures, and old waivers could remain valid indefinitely.
matching_prs.remedy: Unify validation and make actual Chromium decoding and stale-waiver checks blocking.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The browser test calls decodeAudioData per referenced file. The validator tracks scoped findings and stale waivers, and the blocking Instrument Validation job runs it.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Treat decodability as a consumer contract and require evidence that each exception still applies.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at ad7f45bd. Closed unmerged. A related approach appears in #53.

matching_prs.title: Add license-first Sample Lab workflow
matching_prs.weakness: The existing listening page disclosed sources before voting, mismatched reference pitch and did not retain decisions.
matching_prs.remedy: Build a blind, randomized comparison with common target pitch, level matching, recorded choices and separate objective gates.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The core validates declared root pitch and audit inputs. The generated lab applies active-RMS gain and delayed identity reveal.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: For a subjective comparison, control pitch and level, blind identity and record the choice before revealing it.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: No GitHub head check rollup at df11ad21. Closed unmerged with no head check rollup. Listening and Chromium results in the PR are author-reported.

matching_prs.title: Replace legacy sample processing with Pipeline v2
matching_prs.weakness: The legacy sample pipeline could act on unbound evidence and simulated results without proving the exact encoded bytes worked in supported browsers.
matching_prs.remedy: Bind evidence to promoted bytes, preserve negative controls, and add a real encode-to-decode boundary contract.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: A committed WAV is encoded by real ffmpeg and the exact output is decoded in Chromium and WebKit. Evidence tests cover missing roots, velocity gaps, orphan deliveries and stale evidence.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Keep a real end-to-end contract alongside cheap checks and bind its evidence to the artifact it certifies.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at 08162997. Includes work related to closed #51 and #52. The real-contract suite is conditional outside its designated lane.

matching_prs.title: Complete sampled-instrument evaluation and harden the pipeline
matching_prs.weakness: Pipeline measurements and listening records needed to distinguish a mechanical pass from human approval and to reject absent browser evidence.
matching_prs.remedy: Validate the decision ledger against exact artifacts and add negative tests around incomplete gate summaries.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The full-pipeline test makes missing Chromium/WebKit summary gates fail. Decision tests bind ten human rejections to candidate hashes and preserve unresolved findings.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Require each decision to identify its measured artifact and preserve the limits of what each type of evidence proves.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at 12a5ce8c. The PR disclosed bypassing a local real-backend smoke after a stale fixture failure.

matching_prs.title: Fix note dynamics, synth release tails, and tempo sync
matching_prs.weakness: The scheduler matrix expected the shared track fader to receive the per-note lock, encoding the double-attenuation bug. Parameter inspection also missed release-tail silence.
matching_prs.remedy: Correct the existing oracle and measure the emitted PCM after note-off.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The old trackVolume × lock expectation becomes no shared-fader call. A native offline renderer requires audible early-tail RMS and later decay.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Independently verify signal routing and its audible consequence.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at 8e3b185e. The native renderer used an availability skip at this revision, a pattern subsequently addressed in #122.

matching_prs.title: Add accessible icons and harden session workflows
matching_prs.weakness: Browser accessibility checks could log an issue, select zero controls, or complete without exercising the interaction.
matching_prs.remedy: Make computed names and actual keyboard actions blocking and run fixture-compatible cases on the appropriate backend.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The visible button/link test asserts a nonempty population and accessible names. Keyboard tests observe real focus and step actions, and p-lock editor coverage runs in the mock lane where possible.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Prove meaningful inputs were discovered and assert the visible result of user input before granting a pass.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at 6f7d61d9.

matching_prs.title: Implement stateless MCP rhythm slice
matching_prs.weakness: The new onboarding journey initially accepted an HTML app shell as proof that agent edits had persisted.
matching_prs.remedy: Replace the shell marker with a read of authoritative stored session state.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: In commit b7fb4a66, GET of /s/:id and id="root" become GET /api/sessions/:id and assertions on tempo, track ID and active step positions.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: After a write, read back the values whose persistence the journey claims.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at b7fb4a66. This repair followed an earlier commit on the same PR and is visible in its commit history.

matching_prs.title: Replace drifting test doubles with production-boundary tests
matching_prs.weakness: Tests of a parallel Durable Object implementation and random chaos stubs could stay green while the real collaboration path broke.
matching_prs.remedy: Remove those parallel implementations and exercise real Workers, sockets and the production client with controlled faults.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: Deletes the fake's connection-count assertions, random drop-rate bins, and a mobile test adding constants. The replacement imports SELF and evictDurableObject and checks the real upgrade and snapshot protocol.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Keep the production state machine in the test and inject only the boundary failures you need.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at 67aa1ec1.

matching_prs.title: Add a runnable deployment smoke for the stateless MCP endpoint
matching_prs.weakness: Local SELF-based onboarding tests could not show that a deployed endpoint completed the documented journey.
matching_prs.remedy: Add a runnable smoke against an explicit deployment using the official client and process failure on unmet checks.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The script drives a deployed session through discovery, read/edit/read and persisted session checks and throws for failed assertions.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Keep an opt-in, narrowly scoped real-deployment contract when an in-process test cannot observe deployment wiring.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at 6565a13b. This review verified the smoke implementation without running it against a deployment.

matching_prs.title: test: replace tests that could not fail, and gate the patterns that let them in
matching_prs.weakness: Tested facades were unreachable from production, reducer paths delegated to the same mutation function, empty discovery could prove 0 equals 0, and some specs had no executable tests.
matching_prs.remedy: Replace copied or vacuous checks, require witnessed changes, delete uncollected duplicates, and gate recurrence.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The reducer cases require a state change. An empty browser spec is deleted, and analyzer fixtures explicitly cover single-line and parameterized tests with zero assertions. The audit maps deleted claims to live owners.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Break the production behavior named by a test. Require an observed failure or replace the test with one that distinguishes the defect.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at 65692cad. The PR reports targeted fault injections. The audit did not rerun those injections.

matching_prs.title: Publish Keyboardia Agent Skill discovery and MCP safeguards
matching_prs.weakness: The pre-existing deployment journey could pass while Cloudflare's well-known skill-discovery route returned 404. A successful tool exchange alone did not prove the catalog and referenced skill were available.
matching_prs.remedy: Add an independent deployment smoke for the served catalog, redirect policy, MIME and exact bytes before accepting the MCP journey.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The smoke calculates a SHA-256 digest of the served skill and compares it with the catalog. Tests cover bounded redirects and the deployment script invokes the discovery smoke before the MCP smoke.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: When a dependency is discovered by URL, fetch the deployed artifact through the discovery route and validate its identity.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at b87c72ec. This is a deployed protocol verification change. The follow-up #83 separately evaluates agent behavior.

matching_prs.title: Fix session contracts and enforce Worker E2E coverage
matching_prs.weakness: Manual real-Worker E2E selection and silent returns/skips could yield a green job without exercising collaboration. The runner could also stop draining backend output.
matching_prs.remedy: Declare Worker-only ownership, fail required prerequisites and validate the result inventory.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The required-files manifest selects Worker-owned specs. Helpers enforce the expected backend, and the full-stack runner runs Playwright asynchronously while the Worker emits logs.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Make the required runtime, collected cases and outcome of the chosen lane observable.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at dbf9abe5.

matching_prs.title: Type-check the rest of scripts/, and fix what that surfaced
matching_prs.weakness: Most verification scripts were outside TypeScript checking, and the existing manifest validator advertised --fix while returning success without fixing anything.
matching_prs.remedy: Include the scripts in build checking and make the unsupported validator operation fail explicitly.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The new CLI test executes the validator with --fix and requires exit 2 and a clear unchanged-files diagnostic. The MIDI verifier drops its weaker local event type.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Exercise the actual verification command's failure mode when an advertised operation cannot succeed.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at c6824e2c. The PR separately identifies an unresolved detector heuristic. A successful build does not establish that heuristic works.

matching_prs.title: Add agent session lifecycle, analysis, and MIDI export tools
matching_prs.weakness: Browser suites navigated to a production UUID and depended on pre-seeded content. Keyboard focus tests assumed the same traversal gesture in different engines.
matching_prs.remedy: Create a populated session on the backend under test and issue the engine's full-control tab gesture.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: createPopulatedSessionWithRetry constructs known tracks and steps per run. Existing accessibility specs use it and pressKeyboardTab sends Alt with Tab on WebKit.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Own the fixture on the active backend and reach user state via that platform's real input behavior.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at c8de1f27.

matching_prs.title: Prewarm MCP-added sampled instruments during playback
matching_prs.weakness: Tests around picker-based preload could pass while a sampled track introduced through another client never sounded during playback.
matching_prs.remedy: Expand the existing prewarm hook suite and drive a real MCP-to-browser audio journey.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The old skip-prewarm assumption for non-Tone tracks is narrowed. The browser spec checks instrument fetch/decode/readiness and per-track audible output without restarting playback.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: For behavior shared across entry points, verify a second entry point at the common runtime boundary.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at 202bb6a0.

matching_prs.title: Refactor runtime boundaries around Worker and browser adapters
matching_prs.weakness: Source and architecture checks could overlook indirect imports, comments mistaken for imports, or a corrupt browser-worker MIDI export.
matching_prs.remedy: Use a syntax-aware transitive runtime scanner with adversarial fixtures and validate a real browser-downloaded MIDI artifact.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: Scanner tests distinguish executable imports from comments and strings and exercise unresolved/transitive edges. Browser coverage awaits download and inspects MIDI bytes.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Validate the executable dependency graph and the delivered output, including representative ways the check could be fooled.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at 15ab5040.

matching_prs.title: feat: change a track's instrument from the browser, WebSocket, and MCP (#63)
matching_prs.weakness: The instrument-change browser fixture used 64 slots for a 128-slot production contract and its initial checks missed focus restoration and viewport clipping.
matching_prs.remedy: Repair fixture dimensions and add observable focus, rotation and geometry assertions during the PR's audit.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: Commit 6b1beb73 changes 64-element step arrays to 128 and measures picker bounds against the track viewport after scrolling, then checks the returned focus after interaction.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Feed integration tests valid production-shaped state and assert the user-visible boundaries that ordinary success misses.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at 6b1beb73. The fixture correction is visible in the PR's intermediate-to-final diff.

matching_prs.title: fix: enforce MCP transport and eval invariants
matching_prs.weakness: The deployment smoke skipped browser preflight, and the evaluation scorer rewarded no-ops, existing work and collateral changes.
matching_prs.remedy: Exercise cross-origin preflight and score requested state deltas against explicit new/existing baseline tracks.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The smoke checks OPTIONS for 204 and expected CORS headers. Eval tests require hard failure for erasing a collaborator or submitting duplicate scattershot guesses.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Use negative controls that would score well by accident and preserve unrelated baseline state.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at 6b2eef5e.

matching_prs.title: Harden and publish Keyboardia MCP directory metadata
matching_prs.weakness: String-based workflow policy tests could approve shell code that failed when it actually validated a publication artifact.
matching_prs.remedy: Run the workflow's exact verification shell against approved and surplus-file fixtures.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: Commit 070f29de extracts the workflow step, asserts it is present, executes it with bash in a temporary directory containing server.json, then checks rejection with an extra file.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Execute the shipped verifier against positive and negative artifacts when text assertions cannot establish its behavior.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at 05c59912. The same-PR repair is traceable to commit 070f29de.

matching_prs.title: Add source-bound evaluation infrastructure for the Keyboardia Agent Skill
matching_prs.weakness: Existing conformance tests proved that the skill was published, without demonstrating that an agent discovered it, followed its guidance and preserved the requested edit.
matching_prs.remedy: Add paired evaluations, independent journey oracles, and receipts bound to actual prompts and harness inputs.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The discovery oracle tests one correlated origin-to-digest-to-read/edit/read trace, and receipt tests bind resolved prompt bytes and inputs. Separate adapters allow deterministic offline plumbing tests.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Keep protocol conformance, application outcome and agent efficacy as distinct claims with evidence for each.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at a2bac248. Offline stubs establish harness plumbing. The PR did not establish live model efficacy.

matching_prs.title: Add an executable Sonnet v11 evaluation handoff
matching_prs.weakness: The prior evaluation handoff left repeated measurements, external harness bytes, provider failures and prepared task identities open to inconsistent interpretation.
matching_prs.remedy: Publish an exact executable protocol for a frozen benchmark and mark the old runbook historical.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The handoff pins source, harness and task hashes, distinguishes eight independent prompts from 48 repeated calls and excludes failed or incomplete provider observations.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Freeze experimental inputs and distinguish the independent sampling unit from repeated calls.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at cbe8a56a. Documentation-only protocol. No new model outcomes were collected by this PR.

matching_prs.title: Implement evidence-backed sound-quality parity plan
matching_prs.weakness: A successful decode or audible meter could miss late encoded onsets and distinguish neither overload nor which stage changed the heard mix.
matching_prs.remedy: Measure onset from decoded browser samples and capture synchronized PCM from multiple stages of the actual graph.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The decoder walks actual frames to measure leadingSilenceMs and compares against calibration. The capture test records pre-compressor, post-makeup and heard-output PCM.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Validate the decoded delivered asset and compare synchronized signals at meaningful boundaries.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at 0d1834fe. Objective checks do not independently verify subjective sound preference.

matching_prs.title: refactor: consolidate Stack A component CSS with identity gate
matching_prs.weakness: A focused CSS catalogue could pass with a different cascade from production, while a real-audio browser test had no supported WebKit disposition.
matching_prs.remedy: Compare base and candidate under production stylesheet ordering and record unsupported WebKit execution explicitly.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The identity suite takes screenshots and computed contracts of both revisions. The multiplayer pan case limits the unsupported WebKit path and remains gating in Chromium.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: A differential harness must reproduce production ordering and expose unsupported environments explicitly.
matching_prs.verification_caveat: GitHub head check rollup SUCCESS at 719d0f1c. The full-app identity approach was subsequently reconsidered in #130.

matching_prs.title: feat: complete flat Stack B dropdown pilot and restore focus ownership
matching_prs.weakness: Whole-screen identity checks could not describe which differences were intentional, or detect lost focus amid an approved dropdown redesign.
matching_prs.remedy: Define allowed token and pixel regions, retain geometry outside them, and test focus after dismissal.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The differential suite checks for geometry changes and pixels outside approved regions. Existing mobile behavior tests now require the trigger to regain focus.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Describe allowed changes narrowly and keep separate interaction assertions for behavior pixels cannot establish.

matching_prs.title: Add WAL-Reset learnings and bounded correctness test lanes
matching_prs.weakness: Example-based scheduling and sync tests missed overlapping mutations, rewound sequence numbers and dropped or duplicated audio onsets. Full-page load waits also made browser readiness fragile.
matching_prs.remedy: Generate replayable schedules, compare observed concurrency and rendered audio to independent invariants, and wait only for the navigation milestone that is needed.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The offline render requires every scheduled kick to be audible exactly once and on time. The overlap test checks client convergence, and the browser-context regression checks DOMContentLoaded plus explicit caller overrides.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: For concurrency, vary the schedule and assert conservation and convergence at observable boundaries.

matching_prs.weakness: A generator could exercise a transition without proving its oracle noticed broken behavior, and an ephemeral failing seed did not preserve the minimal schedule.

matching_prs.diff_evidence: The failure helper emits a structured minimized case. Promotion tests parse runner-prefixed markers and deduplicate examples. The suite also retains the validateSessionState([]) counterexample.

matching_prs.title: Simplify test verification and strengthen correctness contracts
matching_prs.weakness: Weak and duplicate browser tests, duplicated totals and phase-sensitive PCM windows could each create misleading verification.

matching_prs.title: Close fail-open verification paths and reduce repeated test work
matching_prs.weakness: Required jobs could pass after native audio import failure, on an empty receipt inventory, or against an unintended backend. Negative tests repeated an expensive PCM build.
matching_prs.remedy: Fail on missing evidence or native audio, isolate required test lanes, reuse an authentic PCM fixture and expose retry reasons.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The analyzer identifies dynamic import failures converted to skips. API helper tests require a first 5xx to fail and annotate bounded transport/429 retries. Matrix tamper checks reuse one report.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: A required lane must fail if its subject cannot load. Keep retries visible and isolate each tamper on a genuine fixture.

matching_prs.diff_evidence: The instrument-range test waits on waitForBackgroundLoad(), then requires the number of loaded roots. The explicit lane captures the render file outside the *.render.test.ts glob.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Bind waits to actual completion, then assert the result, and give each expensive suite one execution owner.

exclusions.reason: Specifications, research, documentation, design or licensing. #3 analyzes musical surface area. #74 and #105 retrospectively document earlier landed work whose substantive test changes are counted at their originating PRs.

Product implementation, ordinary new-feature coverage, or routine expectation/fixture updates to the changed product. #15/#17 add synthesis and routing coverage; #34 adds social preview coverage; #87 retains earlier verification work on rebase and adds envelope-authoring feature checks. The audio refactors here update their new owners without a separate test-quality repair. #108 is counted for specifically deleting tested-but-unreachable policy.

Standard initial CI enablement (#11), lint/warnings, runtime/dependency/version changes, or workflow supply-chain pinning. #128 changes the transitive dependency version asserted by an existing eval test; #133 is an open dependency bot update. No distinct test-oracle repair was identified.

limitations: The historical study inspected PR metadata, all changed-file inventories and plausible test/tooling diffs, including selected same-PR intermediate commits. Large binary media and visual snapshot contents were not interpreted as evidence of test effectiveness.

Outcome labels are GitHub aggregate status for the recorded head as of enumeration. Per-test, performance, mutation, listening and deployment outcomes reported by authors were not independently rerun. An aggregate pass can include skipped, conditional or advisory lanes.

Entries count PR attempts, not independent fixes. Especially distinguish the related #51/#52/#53 sample work and #123/#126/#122 verification changes. The two documentation proposals are labeled separately from executable work.
